p06-dusk.chapter: III · The Rats in the Wall
p06-dusk.note: Dusk inside the ring wall: the loot against the stones, the sky going dark.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub. Inside a small ring of huge rough cyclopean stones, open to the sky: blocks with dark gaps between them, dry earth underfoot, a few fallen stones, and three iron-bound strongboxes of loot on a low stone shelf against the wall. Deep blue sky above the wall just going dark, the last faint light on its top edge. No fire, no lamps, no people. Deep focus. Nothing modern.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic dusk photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. None of its smooth surfaces survive: real limestone, dry-stone, earth, scrub; blob trees become real pines. Inside a small ruined ring of huge rough cyclopean stones, open to the sky, solid all round with no gate: dry earth underfoot, fallen stones, three iron-bound strongboxes on a low stone shelf, a timber ladder drawn up against the inner face. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its bandit's dress exactly (purple tunic and cloak, bronze bracers) and its strongbox. He stands alone among the boxes, looking up at the darkening sky above the wall. Deep blue sky, last light on the wall's top edge. No fire, no lamps, no other people. Nothing modern.
